common.name: Name
common.addressHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.
common.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
common.conflict: This short name is already in use. Choose another.
common.copyError: Copying was blocked. Select the key above and copy it manually.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.success: Check your email for a verification link, then sign in.

checkEmail.title: Verify your email
checkEmail.description: Request a new verification link if the previous one expired.
checkEmail.success: If the address can be verified, a link is on its way. Check your inbox.

forgot.title: Forgot password?
forgot.description: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.success: If the address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: This link can be used once.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

invitation.title: Join your team
invitation.description: Sign in with the invited email address, or create your account here.

errors.generic: We could not complete this request. Please try again.
errors.unverified: Verify your email before signing in. You can request a new link below.
errors.inviteOnly: Account creation requires an invitation. Ask your team for a link.
errors.noEmail: Email is unavailable on this installation. Contact the administrator.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.expired: This link is invalid, expired, or belongs to a different account. Request a new link.
errors.lastOwner: A team must have at least one owner. Keep another owner before removing this role.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.credentials: Check your email address and password and try again.

dashboard.chooseOrganization: Choose an organization above, or create one to get started.
dashboard.accessLost: This organization or project is unavailable. Your access may have changed. Choose another organization or contact an owner.
dashboard.forbidden: Only owners and administrators can change these settings.

projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one for your website.
projects.domainsHint: One website origin per line, including https:// (or http:// for local development). Include the port when needed; do not include paths.
projects.anyOrigin: Allow submissions from any website. Leaving this list empty allows all websites.
projects.overview: Manage this website’s backend features and integration settings.
projects.noModules: No website features are available yet on this installation.
projects.allDomains: All websites are allowed. Restrict this in Settings before sharing a publishable key.
projects.invalid: Check the fields and use a full website origin such as https://example.com, without a path.

keys.title: Access keys
keys.publicHint: Use this key in your website. It only allows supported public actions. Restrict allowed websites in Settings.
keys.secretHint: Keep this key on your server or in your coding agent’s private settings. Never add it to website code.
keys.revokeDescription: Any integration using this key will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
keys.guidance: Use a publishable key for your website and a secret key only for private integrations. Allowed websites protect public requests; they do not make a secret key safe to publish.
keys.noPublicKey: No active publishable key. Ask an owner or administrator to create one.
keys.noPermission: Only owners and administrators can create or revoke keys.
keys.revealDescription: Copy it to a safe place now. A secret key is shown only once. Closing this window clears it from the dashboard.

agent.title: Coding agent
agent.description: Reads integration and configuration details, updates configuration, and reads usage. No personal records, deletion, or key management.

server.title: Server integration
server.description: Allows submissions to enabled website features. No personal record reads, deletion, or key management.

data.title: Data access
data.description: Explicitly grants reading and editing personal records plus usage reads. No deletion or key management. Share only with a trusted private integration.

members.roleHint: Members can view project settings and integration details. Administrators can also manage projects, keys, team members and activity. Ownership transfer is unavailable.
members.changeDescription: The new permissions take effect immediately. A team must keep at least one owner.
members.removeDescription: This person will immediately lose access to this organization. Their account and access to other organizations remain available.
members.linkDescription: Email is unavailable. Share this link privately with the invited person. It only works with their matching email address and expires.
members.copyError: Copying was blocked. Select the invitation link and copy it manually.

activity.description: Administrative actions from the last year. Names, personal records and secret keys are never included.

forms.unavailable: Forms aren't switched on for this installation.

empty.title: No forms yet
empty.description: Create a form from a template below, then add it to your website. Entries show up here.
empty.embed: How to add a form to your website

entries.summary: {{total}} entries, {{unread}} unread, {{spam}} in the spam folder.
entries.deleteDescription_one: The selected entry is deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
entries.deleteDescription_other: The {{count}} selected entries are deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
entries.deleteOneDescription: The entry is deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
entries.none: No entries match. New entries show up here as soon as they arrive.
entries.caption: Entries
entries.selectAll: Select all entries on this page
entries.additionalHint: Values for fields that are no longer part of the form, or that the website sent without a field.

settings.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can change these settings. You can view them.
settings.proofOfWork: Check that a real browser sends the form
settings.proofOfWorkHint: Recommended. Without this check, only the hidden trap field and request limits keep bots out.
settings.honeypot: Name of the hidden trap field
settings.honeypotHint: Bots fill this invisible field; such entries are dropped. Keep the default unless it clashes with one of your fields.
settings.retentionHint_one: Entries are deleted automatically {{count}} day after they arrive. Spam is deleted after 30 days.
settings.retentionHint_other: Entries are deleted automatically {{count}} days after they arrive. Spam is deleted after 30 days.
settings.unlimitedHint: Entries are kept until you delete them. Only choose this if you have a reason to keep personal data that long. Spam is still deleted after 30 days.
settings.redirectsHint: For forms on plain web pages: where visitors go after sending. Leave empty to show a simple confirmation instead.
settings.redirectOutside: This address isn't on one of your project's allowed domains, so it will be refused. Add the domain in the project settings or use another page.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.noEmail: Email isn't set up on this installation, so no notifications are sent. Ask whoever runs Backbricks to configure email.
notifications.removeDescription: The chosen members stop getting emails about new entries in this form.
notifications.add: Notify these members about new entries
notifications.noMembers: No member has confirmed their email address yet.
notifications.includeContent: Include the entry's content in the email
notifications.contentWarning: Email is less protected than Backbricks: the content leaves the system and stays in inboxes. Without this option, emails only say that an entry arrived and link to it.

danger.title: Delete and archive
danger.deleteAllDescription: Permanently delete all {{total}} entries of this form. This can't be undone.
danger.deleting: The entries are being deleted. This can take a moment.
danger.archiveDescription: Archiving stops the form from accepting entries.
danger.archiveWithEntries: Archiving stops the form from accepting entries. Its entries are kept until their deletion date, so delete them first if you no longer need them.
danger.archiveConfirm: The form stops accepting entries and disappears from the inbox.

errors.stale: Someone else changed this form in the meantime. Reload to see the latest settings, then make your change again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this. Ask an owner or administrator.
errors.keyTaken: This short name is already used by another form. Choose another.

fields.title: Fields
fields.intro: These are the fields your website sends. Changes apply to new entries; existing entries keep what they were sent.
fields.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can change the fields. You can view them.
fields.consentDefault: I agree that my details are stored to answer my request.
fields.label: Label
fields.keyHint: Your website uses this name to send the value. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
fields.keyFixed: The short name can't change after saving. Add a new field instead.

rules.identifiesSubject: Use this email to find the person's entries for privacy requests

fields.confirmTitle: Save changes that affect existing entries?
fields.confirmDescription: Websites that still send the old fields may get errors until you update them.

changes.removed: "{{label}}" is removed. Existing entries keep its answers under "Additional data".
changes.typeChanged: "{{label}}" changes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Existing answers stay as they were sent.
changes.optionsRemoved: "{{label}}" loses the choices {{options}}. Existing entries keep the old choices.
changes.other: This change affects how existing entries are checked or shown.

embed.label: Ways to add the form
embed.noKey: This project has no publishable key yet, so the code shows a placeholder.
embed.origins: Only these websites can send entries: {{origins}}.
embed.anyOrigin: Any website can send entries. Restrict this to your domains in the project settings.
embed.honeypot: Keep the hidden field "{{name}}" in your form: bots fill it and their entries are dropped.
embed.htmlHint: Works without JavaScript. After sending, visitors go to the page set under Settings.
embed.htmlNeedsPowOff: This form checks for a real browser, which plain HTML can't pass. Switch the check off under Settings, or use the SDK.
embed.htmlNeedsRedirect: Set a page for after sending under Settings; plain HTML forms need one.
embed.sdkHint: For websites with JavaScript. Add the form to your page and the script to your site's code; the SDK passes the browser check automatically.
embed.serverHint: For your own server code. Use a secret key with the "Server integration" preset in the {{env}} environment variable. Never put a secret key in website code.
